axes.name: tm_log_est
axes.verdict_first_rule: time-axis check — along cfg.stages it moves one way only: holding every other field of the fastest config, the time is lowest in the middle of the range on 5 of 44 training shapes, and your axis is lowest at an end on 5 of those. (Picking the lowest value alone gives a regret of 1.146 on these shapes.) A time axis has to be lowest where the time is: write it as the sum, or the larger, of an effect that falls and one that rises as that field grows, each a time from hw.* rates.
